article_blocks.text: Strain Type: Balanced Hybrid
Genetics: Sherb N’ Sour × Baker’s Dozen
Breeder: Exotic Genetix
THC Content: 20–24%
CBD Content: 1%
Terpene Profile: Limonene , Caryophyllene , Myrcene
Primary Flavors: Sour lemon, lime, diesel, sweet cookie
Flowering Time (Indoor): 63 days
Outdoor Harvest Time: October
Indoor Yield: Very High
Outdoor Yield: High
Grow Difficulty: Intermediate

The unmistakable bite of sour citrus and pungent fuel forms the opening act of Wicked Fabuloso , but the real surprise comes afterward. Beneath its sharp lemon-lime fragrance lies a rich mixture of vanilla frosting, sweet cookie dough, and warm bakery spice, creating an aromatic personality that shifts dramatically as the flowers are handled. Developed by Exotic Genetix, this balanced cannabis hybrid combines Sherb N’ Sour with Baker’s Dozen, bringing together two contrasting branches of contemporary American marijuana breeding.

One parent supplies the aggressive citrus and gasoline qualities associated with Sour Power OG genetics, while the other introduces the creamy sweetness and substantial flower production of the Cookies family . The resulting cultivar develops vigorous branches, dense resin-coated buds, and a psychoactive experience that balances mental euphoria with gradually intensifying physical relaxation. Released within the Baker’s Dozen Reloaded collection, Wicked Fabuloso represents a distinctive combination of old-school sour weed characteristics and modern dessert-inspired genetics.
Genetics and Lineage

The foundation of Wicked Fabuloso begins with Sherb N’ Sour, an Exotic Genetix creation combining Sour Power OG with Power Sherb. Sour Power OG originated from the breeding work of Karma Genetics and Hortilab Seeds, bringing together Sour Power and Biker Kush. Sour Power descends from Star Bud and East Coast Sour Diesel , introducing the sharp citrus, chemical fuel, and penetrating sour characteristics that helped establish Diesel genetics as an important influence in modern cannabis breeding. Biker Kush contributes heavier OG-related traits, including earthy spice, dense resin production, and substantial physical effects. The combination provides Sherb N’ Sour with a particularly expressive aromatic foundation. Power Sherb introduces a contrasting influence through Sunset Sherbet and Cookies and Cream IX3 genetics, contributing sweeter fruit, creamy dessert notes, and flower development associated with the contemporary Cookies family .

Baker’s Dozen supplies the second half of the pedigree. Originally developed by Exotic Genetix, this hybrid combines Milk & Cookies with Rainbow Chip . Milk & Cookies descends from Cookies & Cream and Triple OG, reinforcing characteristics associated with sweet vanilla, baked dough, and pungent Kush aromas. Cookies & Cream itself originated from Girl Scout Cookies and Starfighter F2, bringing additional resin potential and aromatic complexity. Rainbow Chip combines Sunset Sherbet with Mint Chocolate Chip , introducing ripe fruit sweetness, herbal mint, subtle chocolate, and colorful flowering characteristics. Together, these ancestors establish a particularly rich genetic background that encompasses Sour Diesel , OG Kush , Girl Scout Cookies, and modern Sherbet-related breeding lines.

Exotic Genetix developed Wicked Fabuloso using Sherb N’ Sour as the female parent and a reversed Baker’s Dozen selection as the pollen donor. The resulting feminized hybrid belongs to the breeder’s Baker’s Dozen Reloaded collection, a series designed to combine Baker’s Dozen genetics with other desirable cultivars. This pairing brings together contrasting sour and sweet characteristics while preserving the structural qualities associated with heavy flower production. The breeder classifies the finished plant as a balanced 50/50 hybrid, with medium-to-tall growth, strong lateral branching, and a relatively manageable flowering period.
Effects and Experience

Wicked Fabuloso offers a psychoactive progression in which the cerebral and physical components remain closely connected. The initial experience may involve a noticeable elevation in mood, increased enjoyment of sensory activities, and a more playful mental perspective. Music can become unusually engaging, conversation may feel more spontaneous, and familiar surroundings can acquire a heightened sense of interest. The Sour Power OG ancestry contributes to expectations of an uplifting cerebral beginning, while the Sherbet and Cookies influences provide a calmer foundation. This combination may appeal to experienced cannabis consumers who appreciate mental stimulation without the intense, restless character sometimes associated with strongly energizing sativa varieties.

A gradual shift toward bodily relaxation often accompanies the later stages of intoxication. Muscular tension may become less noticeable, physical restlessness can diminish, and the initial mental activity may settle into a comfortable sense of calm. Moderate amounts may complement leisurely afternoons or relaxed social evenings, while larger doses can produce substantial heaviness, fatigue, or reduced motivation. THC concentration and personal tolerance determine how strongly these effects develop. Commercial potency descriptions suggest that this hybrid can deliver significant intoxication, making cautious consumption important for inexperienced individuals. Excessive THC exposure may cause dizziness, dry mouth, increased heart rate, anxiety, or impaired concentration. Even when the experience feels mentally uplifting, cannabis can interfere with coordination, judgment, and reaction time.
Medical Benefits

The combination of mental uplift and physical relaxation may interest medical marijuana patients exploring cannabinoid-based approaches to persistent discomfort. THC interacts with the body’s endocannabinoid system, influencing neurological signaling involved in pain perception, appetite, and other physiological processes. Clinical research suggests that certain cannabinoid preparations may offer modest benefits for selected chronic pain conditions, although effectiveness varies according to the formulation and individual circumstances. A balanced hybrid may appeal to people who prefer an initially engaging experience rather than immediate sedation. Nevertheless, the therapeutic effectiveness of Wicked Fabuloso has not been established through strain-specific clinical trials, and its genetic ancestry does not independently demonstrate medical benefits.

Stress-related symptoms, reduced appetite, and difficulty unwinding represent additional reasons some individuals consider THC-dominant cannabis. Temporary euphoria may change the subjective experience of everyday stress, while the later relaxing phase can encourage rest. THC may also stimulate hunger in certain circumstances. These potential effects require careful consideration because high-potency weed can worsen anxiety, impair memory, and contribute to tolerance or dependence with frequent consumption. Repeated THC exposure may also affect normal sleep patterns. Patients taking prescription medications or managing cardiovascular or psychiatric conditions should consult a qualified healthcare professional before using cannabis. Product-specific laboratory testing and individual medical circumstances remain essential when evaluating potential medical applications.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

The aromatic character of Wicked Fabuloso is defined by the collision of sharp, almost acidic citrus and rich bakery sweetness. Fresh flowers may release an immediate fragrance of lemon zest, sour lime, and pungent diesel, followed by subtler impressions of sweet orange and resinous herbs. The Sherb N’ Sour parent contributes much of this aggressive opening character, particularly the sour fuel qualities inherited from Sour Power OG. Breaking apart mature buds reveals a softer aromatic foundation reminiscent of vanilla frosting, freshly mixed cookie dough, and warm pastry. Baker’s Dozen reinforces these dessert characteristics while adding mild berry sweetness and occasional herbal spice. The resulting fragrance offers a sharper, more pungent alternative to conventional sugary Cookies hybrids.

Its terpene composition is generally associated with limonene, beta-caryophyllene, and myrcene, although the relative concentrations vary between individual selections. Limonene contributes recognizable citrus brightness, particularly the lemon and lime qualities that dominate the opening fragrance. Beta-caryophyllene introduces peppery warmth and woody depth, helping connect the brighter aromas with the heavier Kush-related characteristics. Myrcene may reinforce earthy, herbal, and mildly fruity notes. Additional volatile compounds contribute to the distinctive sour-diesel and creamy vanilla impressions, which cannot be explained by conventional terpenes alone. On the palate, tart citrus may appear first before developing into sweet cookie dough, vanilla cream, and a lingering peppery fuel finish. Proper drying and curing help preserve these contrasting aromatic layers, while prolonged exposure to heat and oxygen can diminish their intensity.
Growing Information

Wicked Fabuloso combines vigorous hybrid growth with substantial flower production, creating a plant that benefits from deliberate canopy management. Exotic Genetix describes a medium-to-tall cultivar with a multi-topped bush structure capable of supporting numerous productive flowering sites. Healthy specimens may develop strong lateral branches, relatively open internodal spacing, and dense clusters of flowers as maturity approaches. The Sherb N’ Sour ancestry contributes vigorous development and potentially greater vertical growth, while Baker’s Dozen reinforces dense flower formation and considerable resin production. Individual phenotypes may differ in height, branching density, and overall architecture, particularly when different expressions of the sour and dessert-oriented parental genetics become prominent.

Indoor flowering generally requires approximately 63 days, placing the cultivar within a manageable nine-week production window. Exotic Genetix classifies yield potential as monstrous, reflecting the substantial production characteristics associated with its Baker’s Dozen breeding program. Exact grams-per-square-meter figures have not been standardized across individual plants. Its naturally branching structure can support an even canopy, allowing light to reach numerous flowering sites rather than concentrating production entirely within the central cola. Training methods that distribute branches evenly may help manage vertical growth, while additional structural support can become necessary as dense buds gain weight. Maintaining adequate ventilation is especially important during late flowering because compact, resinous flowers can retain moisture and become vulnerable to fungal contamination.

Outdoor cultivation is possible in regions with abundant sunlight, favorable temperatures, and relatively dry autumn conditions. October provides a preliminary Northern Hemisphere harvest expectation, although exact maturity depends on local climate and phenotype. The plant’s medium-to-tall architecture may support substantial outdoor development when sufficient growing space is available. Mature flowers can display swollen calyxes, prominent pistils, and a dense coating of glandular trichomes, creating the frosted appearance associated with premium Cookies-derived cannabis. Some selections may express darker green or purple pigmentation inherited from the Sherbet and Rainbow Chip families. Careful postharvest handling is particularly important because the cultivar’s bright citrus notes can diminish more rapidly than its heavier earthy characteristics. Controlled drying and curing help preserve the relationship between sour lemon, sweet vanilla, and pungent diesel that defines the finished flower.
FAQ
Is Wicked Fabuloso indica or sativa?

Wicked Fabuloso is a balanced hybrid classified by Exotic Genetix as approximately 50% indica and 50% sativa. Its direct parents are Sherb N’ Sour and Baker’s Dozen. The experience may begin with uplifting cerebral effects before progressing toward physical relaxation. Individual responses vary according to cannabinoid composition, consumption amount, and personal tolerance.
How much THC does Wicked Fabuloso have?

Published seed descriptions identify THC concentrations around 20–24%, although these figures are not guaranteed for every phenotype. The breeder emphasizes substantial potency potential without establishing one universal laboratory-confirmed percentage. Actual THC concentrations depend on cultivation conditions and the individual harvest. CBD levels are generally expected to remain low.
What does Wicked Fabuloso taste like?

The flavor combines sour lemon, fresh lime, pungent diesel, vanilla cream, sweet cookie dough, and subtle peppery spice. Sherb N’ Sour contributes the sharp citrus and fuel characteristics, while Baker’s Dozen introduces bakery sweetness and a creamy finish. Some phenotypes may emphasize sour gasoline, while others express stronger vanilla or cookie aromas.
How long does Wicked Fabuloso take to flower?

Indoor flowering generally requires approximately 63 days, equivalent to nine weeks. Exotic Genetix describes the plant as medium to tall, with vigorous multi-topped growth and exceptionally heavy yield potential. Outdoor harvest timing depends on regional climate and seasonal conditions, with October representing a general Northern Hemisphere expectation.
Who bred Wicked Fabuloso, and what are its parent strains?

Wicked Fabuloso was developed by Exotic Genetix using Sherb N’ Sour as the mother and a reversed Baker’s Dozen selection. Sherb N’ Sour combines Sour Power OG with Power Sherb, while Baker’s Dozen descends from Milk & Cookies and Rainbow Chip. The cultivar was released as feminized photoperiod seeds within the Baker’s Dozen Reloaded collection.
Final Thoughts on Wicked Fabuloso

Wicked Fabuloso illustrates how contrasting cannabis genetics can create a distinctive sensory experience without sacrificing productive plant characteristics. Exotic Genetix combined the aggressive citrus and fuel personality of Sherb N’ Sour with the creamy dessert qualities of Baker’s Dozen, producing a balanced marijuana hybrid recognized for aromatic complexity and substantial flowering potential. Its combination of tart lemon, sour lime, vanilla frosting, cookie dough, and pungent diesel creates an unusual flavor progression that bridges traditional OG and Sour Diesel characteristics with contemporary Cookies genetics.

For experienced consumers, this cannabis strain offers an appealing balance between cerebral euphoria and gradually increasing physical relaxation. Growers may appreciate its vigorous branching, approximately nine-week flowering period, and heavy production potential, particularly when dense, resinous flower development is a priority. Its genetic background also demonstrates the continuing influence of Exotic Genetix’s established breeding lines, including Sherb N’ Sour, Rainbow Chip, and Cookies & Cream. Wicked Fabuloso ultimately represents a flavorful, productive modern weed hybrid that brings together the sharp intensity of sour cannabis with the richer sweetness of dessert-inspired American genetics.
